about: The registry behind every computed slot of the assistant's texts (DESIGN.md section 2.5). A metric is a pure function of (population, period, instant) over the generated data, read as the item's owner reads it: the owner's shops, history window and hidden columns bound the population, and a slot that reaches outside them fails the build. 'store' says where the rows live. checks/check_assistant.py fails on a slot whose metric, dimension, period or format is not listed here.

orders.closed: closed repair orders that are not voided; warranty and internal orders are left out unless the population says order_type
orders.revenue: sum of the bill before tax (en) or as billed, VAT inside (ru) of orders.closed; on one order, that order's bill
orders.cash: paid orders whose payment method is cash
orders.discounted: paid orders with a discount of at least min % (min=) or above min_over % (min_over=) of the bill before tax; approved=yes|no reads discount_approved_by
orders.discounted_share: orders.discounted / orders.cash of the same population, in per cent
orders.discount_pct: one order's discount as a share of its bill before tax
orders.discounted_site: the shop or shops of orders.discounted, as names
orders.on_walkin: orders of the population whose customer is the shop's walk-in record
orders.voided: orders voided; after_payment=yes keeps those that hold a payment row
orders.voided_money: the totals the voided orders still carry
orders.voided_max_per_advisor: the largest orders.voided of any single advisor in the population
orders.waiting_parts: orders in status waiting_parts at the instant
orders.waiting_days_max: calendar days since the status was set, for the longest of orders.waiting_parts
orders.promised_today: open orders whose promised time falls on the period's day
orders.open_over: orders neither closed nor voided for more than days= days
orders.open_days: days one order has been open
till.short_days: closes whose difference is -min or lower (en)
till.short_money: the sum of those differences, as a positive amount (en)
till.short_days_max_per_closer: the largest till.short_days of any single closer in the population (en)
stock.issues_no_sale: stock_movement issues under a person's name with no order line (ru)
stock.issues_no_sale_max_per_person: the largest stock.issues_no_sale of any single person in the population (ru)
labor.overclock_orders: orders on which mechanics clocked more than one hour above the hours sold (ru)
labor.overclock_hours: clocked minus sold hours on those orders (ru)
labor.overclock_money: those hours at the labour hour in force on the order's day (ru)
labor.overclock_orders_max_per_advisor: the largest labor.overclock_orders of any single advisor in the population (ru)
leak.total: en: orders.discount_money + orders.voided_money + till.short_money; ru: orders.discount_money + stock.issues_no_sale_cost + labor.overclock_money; story S2's estimate
rec.sold_share: rec.sold / rec.jobs in per cent, counted in jobs
comebacks.count: orders that another order names as the order it is a comeback of, inside the market's comeback window
bookings.first: the day's first appointment: time, customer, job
bookings.free_slot: the n-th free appointment time of the period at the shop, from its appointment rules
acct.visits: orders of company accounts billed on terms (or of one account) in the period
acct.usual_visits: the account's mean visits per period of the same length over the 90 days before the period
acct.estimates_waiting: estimates sent to us for approval-side action that have waited more than two days for our answer at the instant
acct.overdue_money: unpaid statements (en) or invoices (ru) past the account's terms at the instant, money
acct.days_since_visit: calendar days from the account's last order to the instant
acct.flagged: accounts with no visit in 30 days, an estimate waiting more than two days, or a bill past terms
acct.quiet_name: the name of the account on terms with the most days since its last visit
parts.po_lines: purchase order lines received in the period
parts.on_time_share: lines received on their promised day / parts.po_lines, in per cent
parts.late_orders: purchase orders not fully received and past their promised date at the instant
parts.oldest_late: the oldest of them: supplier and promised day
plan.orders_share: orders.closed of the week / the plan of ledger s10.west_plan.orders, in per cent
plan.revenue_share: orders.revenue of the week / ledger s10.west_plan.revenue, in per cent
customer.last_visit: the day of the customer's last closed order
customer.declined_jobs: the jobs declined on that order, as names
customer.spend: the customer's paid orders, bill before tax
customer.calls: calls whose number is the customer's phone
catalogue.list_price: the list price of a job for a vehicle class and parts tier on the instant's day: labour at the hour in force plus parts
catalogue.price_at_old_hour: the same job at the labour hour before the last rise with today's parts: what a stale service page shows
calls.inbound: inbound calls in opening hours; out-of-hours calls are left out
calls.missed: of calls.inbound, those nobody answered; block=morning keeps the shop's morning block
calls.missed_share: calls.missed / calls.inbound in per cent; with desk=, of the calls that rang that desk first
calls.missed_top_site: the shop with the most calls.missed, as a name
calls.missed_top_desk: the desks of a shop with their missed share, highest first, as text
calls.called_back: missed calls resolved as called_back or got_through
calls.waiting: misses of the last seven days still waiting at the instant (the To call back list)
calls.oldest_waiting: the oldest of calls.waiting: when it was missed (and, as text, the caller as the list shows it)
calls.attempts: unanswered calls back made to one waiting caller
calls.wait_median: median time from a miss to its resolving call
calls.never_share: misses of the period with no resolving call by the instant, in per cent
calls.busiest_hour: the clock hour with the most calls.inbound
calls.scored: a person's calls that carry a score (inbound new enquiries)
calls.visit_share: calls.scored with outcome visit_agreed, in per cent
calls.worst_check: the scorecard check with the lowest mean level, by its name in the tenant's language
calls.best_check: the check with the highest mean level
calls.promised_open: call backs a person promised on a call and has not made at the instant
roster.shifts: published shifts of a person or a site in the period; shift= names a template
roster.on_shift: people with a published shift on the period's day at the site
roster.gaps: places where published shifts fall under the cover requirement, counted per position and block of hours
roster.first_gap: the earliest of them: shop, position, hours
roster.open_shifts: published shifts with nobody on them
roster.free_people: people of the right position with no shift and no unavailability on the gap's day, as names
roster.uncovered_days: days in the period on which a position at a site has no published or draft shift against a requirement
roster.requests_open: shift change requests in state open at the instant
roster.oldest_request: when the oldest open request was filed
roster.late_shifts: shifts clocked in after the grace of ledger late.grace_min
roster.late_share: roster.late_shifts / worked shifts in per cent
roster.no_show_name: the person of a shift flagged as a no-show
board.open: open cards; owner=, kind= and state= narrow them
board.due: open cards whose deadline falls in the period
board.due_today: open cards due on the instant's day
board.overdue: open cards past their deadline at the instant; team=mine is the people the reader may give work to
board.days_overdue: days one card is past its deadline; card= names a planted card
cal.free_slots: times in the period at which every named person is free of meetings, blocks and shifts that exclude them, for the given minutes
cal.meetings: meetings a person is invited to in the period
chats.waiting: open conversations owned by the reader whose last message is the customer's
chats.oldest_waiting: when the longest-waiting of them last wrote
tasks.count: the reader's scheduled tasks, the brief not counted
tasks.next_run: the next due time of a task from its schedule
runs.failed_name: the task name of the reader's newest failed, unsettled run
runs.failed_reason: its reason as the run's row says it
runs.last_failed: the reader's newest failed run: task and day, or 'none'
runs.next_ok_at: when the next run of the same task finished

dimension_values.site: main | east | west | all | home (main and east) | planned (the shops the reader plans) | mine (the reader's own shops)
dimension_values.person, advisor, mechanic, closed_by: a cast slot (6, F1), me, or !slot for everyone but
dimension_values.card: a planted card by its key: s3.early_desk_shift, s6.supplier_change, s16.review

periods.at: the instant itself: a state (a queue, open cards)
periods.day: the business day of the instant, up to the instant
periods.prev_shift: the person's last worked day before the instant
periods.week: Monday of the instant's ISO week to the instant
periods.prev_week: the ISO week before, Monday to Sunday
periods.next_two_weeks: the instant to the end of the roster (T+14 days)
periods.d7, d30, d90: the last 7, 30 or 90 days up to the instant
periods.since_prev: since the reader's previous finished brief
periods.<when>..<when>: between two dates of the date grammar, the second included up to the instant

value_formats.money: the market's money with cents or kopecks
value_formats.dur: hours and minutes (3 h 10 min, 40 min; 3 ч 10 мин)
value_formats.day, weekday, daytime, on_day, on_weekda: a date-valued metric rendered with a date format
value_formats.text: words the metric itself yields (a name, a check's label, a reason)
value_formats.list: a short list in a sentence
value_formats.n:<one>/<other>: en: the number and the noun in the right number
value_formats.n:<one>/<few>/<many>: ru: the number and the noun in the form 1, 2 to 4, 5 and more require

when.grammar: <base>[<+|-><n><unit>]...  base: @event | @now | T | W<+|-k>.<mon..sun> (that weekday of week T+-k; if closed, the next full open day) | P1..P6 (the first day of a score period) | slot<N>:<+|-n> (slot N's n-th working day after or before T). unit: wd:<main|east|west|slotN> (full open days of a shop, or working days of a person; +0wd is the first on or after), d, w, mo, y.

events.@now: the item's own instant: a turn's time, a run's due time, a brief's write time
events.@leak_start: the first full open day on or after T-335 d
events.@money_found: the 5th full open day after G
events.@f1_fired: the 15th full open day after G
events.@note_declined: en: the full open day after the Monday of week T-3; ru: slot 4's next working day after slot 6's first working day on or after the Monday of week T-3 (W-3.mon+0wd:slot6+1wd:slot4; ledger s4.dates, proposal_2)
events.@belt_proposal: en: the full open day after the discount on the timing-belt bill; ru: slot 5's first working day after it (ledger s12.proposal)
